description_en: Queries whether the suggestion feature is enabled for an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 用DescribeAdviceServiceEnabled来查询建议服务是否开启
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-advice-service-enabled --db-cluster-id am-2ze0vp0j6t3to0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAdviceServiceEnabled
